research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Solugen is researching and developing bio-based solutions that replace petroleum-derived products with plant-based alternatives. Their work includes bio-based detergent builders, methods for producing high purity glucaric acid, biobased additives for personal care, multifunctional additives for hydrocarbon desalting, biobased polyesters, and plant biostimulants. These activities focus on sugar oxidation products and their applications in detergents, personal care, agriculture, and industrial processes.

overview_description.description: Solugen is a venture-backed biotech company that replaces petroleum-based products with plant-derived substitutes. They combine the elements of fermentation with the elements of petrochemical processing to create the carbon negative molecular manufacturing platform. They produces chemicals from bio-based feedstocks and is based on breakthroughs in synthetic biology, metal catalyst engineering, and modular plant design. Its solutions will also address clean water, sustainable materials, safer food, and healthy personal care.
